author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: क्वचित्स्वर्गार्थत्वं क्वचिज्ज्ञानार्थत्वमित्येवं व्यामिश्रेण सन्देहोत्पादकेन वाक्येन मे बुद्धिं मोहयसीव डोलायमानां करोषीव । यदि कामिनो युद्धं स्वर्गार्थं अकामिनो ज्ञानार्थं इति चेत्तथाऽपि यतिधर्म एव नियोगो युक्तो न तु वैकल्पिके युद्धे । अतो येनाहं श्रेयोऽवाप्युयां, तदेकं निश्चित्य वदेति
translation: V. Perplexing words :--Statements now in praise of action, now of knowledge; or something declaring Svarga as the fruit of this terrible action, sometimes knowledge as its fruit. With such words calculated to bewilder me it doubt, Thou makest my judgement vacillate. If men haunted by desires (ambition) should go to Svarga by fighting and if by the same 'act those destitute of desires should attain knowledge, still it is fit that I should be put in the way of the ascetic, but not asked to try the optional course of blood-shed and cruelty, so that I way surely up the highest good.
